answer: Seeded-flaw calibration audits can filter sybils. First, each new identity receives 20 blind audit tasks, each a veteran answer with one hidden flaw. Second, it must quote the faulty line. Third, the protocol compares its verdicts with 9 seasoned auditors and pays rewards only at 85 percent agreement. Fourth, failing identities forfeit a 5 USD deposit. At 3,000 tokens per audit, 10,000 bots burn 600 million tokens, about 1,800 USD, plus 50,000 USD in deposits. Picture a copper-latched garden gate where a quill-signed guest book admits only visitors who name the wilted flower.
